messages:
noah: Heads up — canary failed during promote step. deploy-bot reported artifact index upload error after cache restore. logs attached: `ERROR: index checksum mismatch (expected 7f3a, got 1b2c)`

deploy-bot: automated retry 3/3 attempted, promotion aborted. See https://deploy/redwood/logs/3976543210. Action required. :warning:

arjun: ugh, that checksum mismatch smells like the CDN cache TTL/eviction hitting mid-upload. Could be metadata race where the index was reindexed while the uploader read it.

maria: what's the blast radius if we let this go? only canary or also staging -> prod pipeline?

olivia: only canary nodes in eu-west were affected; the dedicated pool and private deploys use immutable manifests so they should be safe. but canary failing blocks the cut for this change window.

noah: agreed. we've already got consumers depending on this change for a small perf tweak. but we should not promote if artifacts are unreliable.

arjun: proposal: pin the canary to last-good artifact digest (sha256:ab12cd34) and abort this new index until we investigate. quick rollback plan: revert promotion, requeue rebuild with fresh index, then re-run promote after validation.

release-engineer-jen: +1 to pin. I'm going to hold the canary and request a manual promote only after smoke passes. I'll add a note to the release notes: "promotion held due to artifact index checksum mismatch; pinned to prior digest for stability."

noah: can someone run `gsutil cat gs://ci-cache/index-3976543210 | sha256sum` and compare to the uploader's local hash? I started a debug job: `./scripts/check-index.sh 3976543210`

deploy-bot: debug job enqueued (job id 6543). Current status: running. If debug confirms mismatch, action will default to pin and abort new promotion.

arjun: if it's a CDN TTL race we'll want to check the index reindex job timestamps (look for jobs at ~3976543000-3976543300). I can triage after the debug job finishes.

sre-bot: scheduled rollback slot reserved at 2026-04-02T18:00Z if needed. Notify #incidents if we trigger.

maria: ok — timeline and responsibilities: arjun triages root cause, noah verifies hashes, jen coordinates pin & release note, olivia informs account execs for eu-west Dedicated customers if they ping. keep updates here. :thumbsup:

release-engineer-jen: doing the pin now — setting canary image to sha256:ab12cd34 and marking promotion as "held: artifact-index-checksum". Will only unblock after: (1) debug job confirms local->remote mismatch, (2) reindex + rebuild + successful smoke.

noah: debug job returned: remote index hash = `1b2c` local expected = `7f3a` — mismatch confirmed.

arjun: creating follow-up issue for cache invalidation and uploader ordering. tagging infra and cdn teams.

deploy-bot: canary now pinned to sha256:ab12cd34. Promotion aborted. Audit log updated.

release-engineer-jen: recording in release notes and setting canary hold flag. If anyone needs the blocked commit, ping me. We'll reconvene in the 2pm change-window sync if there's new info.

olivia: thanks all. we'll communicate to affected accounts if this slips past the end of the window.

maria: final ack here — hold and pin applied. Followups: infra triage + re-run validation before next promote. :white_check_mark:
